content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"This text compares the challenger's chain with the defender's chain and uses the challenger's failure to name Joseph as a reason, so it is doing the chain-vs-chain weighing K-C governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the challenger's seed/loins chain is footed but does not name Joseph as the begetter","rule_words":"the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"never verse by verse: one reading bars using a single verse's lack of the exact name as a reason; the other allows treating the missing name as a chain-footing defect.","why":"The judge treats 'does not name Joseph as the begetter' as a reason for underdetermination, imposing a word-for-word/stating-verse test instead of weighing only chain footing."}
